Why this is not raw LLM chat

Raw model Produces a plausible answer from prompt context. It may be useful, but the buyer still has to verify facts, owners, evidence, approval state, and what happens next.
AbarVa Binds the answer to tenant context, evidence references, Source stages, Move artifacts, value posture, owner/action/gap structure, and human approval.

Honesty boundary

Safe to say: Lakeshore has a synthetic demo tenant with committed loader-backed context records, a document-real Kyriba Source and Moves story, Azure-backed artifacts, and live production screenshots captured through the app.

Do not overstate: value ranges are planning values, not realized savings; downstream Source stages after Executive Decision are artifact-backed preview/review states; the full setup/admin approval ledger is not yet populated.

What this proves

AbarVa helps an executive decide what to do next, what evidence supports the recommendation, what is still missing, and who must approve or hold the move. That is the operating difference: the model is inside a governed execution loop, not floating outside the business.
